text:
Lena Morris: Quick sync on playground schema editor + run history UX. Short list of copy + a11y nits.
Arjun Rao: Go for it.
Lena Morris: 1) Change "Add function schema" -> "Define tool inputs (JSON Schema)", add tiny "Examples" toggle beside it.
Priya Nair: Examples toggle needs aria-expanded and focus-visible. Each example should have "Insert into editor" and announce "Example inserted".
Noah Bennett: We'll implement toggle, aria labels on pre blocks, and a confirm if editor dirty before inserting.
Lena Morris: 2) Run history verbs: replace "Open" with "View invocation details" and add "Re-run with same inputs" as secondary.
Priya Nair: Keyboard: when list focused, single-key shortcuts (r=re-run) OK. Ensure role=list/listitem and aria-selected on items.
Noah Bennett: Also add status pills with hidden text for screen readers: "Status: succeeded, duration 320ms". Avoid relying on color alone.
Lena Morris: 3) Preview behavior: live preview with 600-800ms debounce; pause automatically for large schemas with a banner "Large schema — preview paused".
Priya Nair: Announce updates via aria-live: "Schema preview updated: 3 changes". No auto-scroll.
Noah Bennett: Will send a small staging deploy and include exact copy in PR.
Lena Morris: Thanks — tag me for copy review. :thumbsup:
